title: elaeodendron viburnifolium
intro: Elaeodendron viburnifolium, commonly known as the Fragrant Olive or Viburnum-leaved Elaeodendron, is a plant species in the family Celastraceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Elaeodendron viburnifolium include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve cognitive function, and exhibit antimicrobial properties.
